sources.title: pvt_v2_b2 huggingface.co api & OpenGVLab pvt_v2_b2 github AI Model ...
sources.snippet: pvt_v2_b2 huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides pvt_v2_b2's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this OpenGVLab pvt_v2_b2 model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the pvt_v2_b2 model, and also provides paid use of the pvt_v2_b2. Support call pvt_v2_b2 model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
